questions.question: How does Psalm 103 begin?
options: 'How long, O LORD, will you forget me?'
'Have mercy on me, O God, for I have sinned'
'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'

questions.question: How far does God remove our transgressions from us?
options: As high as the heavens are above us
As wide as the desert sands are spread
As far as the east is from the west
As deep as the sea is from the shore
questions.answer: As far as the east is from the west
